attributes.name: Gas used on transactions
attributes.description: Total gas used on transaction operations on the tezos blockchain per day.
attributes.rich_description:
Total gas used on transaction operations on the tezos blockchain per day. Gas on Tezos can be thought of as an internal resource that is used up by computations from executing transactions and smart contract code, measured in *gas units* (gu).

The amount of gas available is limited both per block and per transaction and is set at the protocol level. As can be seen in the chart, these gas limit parameters have been tuned a handful of times already with the various protocol updates.

Gas used is **not** measured in _xtz_. But it is one of the inputs in calculating the [minimal fee](https://opentezos.com/tezos-basics/economics-and-rewards/) for a transaction.
